learning_outcomes.text: To teach how to analyze the movements of bodies.

syllabus_topics: Stress analysis of elements under tensile and compressive stress
Calculation of deformation and change in shape in axially loaded elements
Torsional shear stress and deformation, power transmission in rotating shafts
Shear force and bending moment diagrams
Calculation of center of gravity and moment of inertia in beams with a specific cross-section
Calculation of bending and shear stresses in beams
Determination of stresses in beams subjected to axial and bending forces, finding the position of the neutral axis
Stress calculation in beams subjected to eccentric loads
Stress in beams under asymmetric loading
Stress-strain calculations and application using Mohr's circle
bibliography: Ders Notları Ferdinant BEER, Strength of Materials
